parameters.text: This is a scanned document with no text layer. Transcribe ALL text you can see, exactly as written: every heading, line item, description, quantity, unit price, amount, total, tax, date, invoice or PO number, and every company name and address. Keep the natural reading order. Output plain text only - no commentary, no markdown, no explanation.

options.systemMessage: Read the document like an office assistant. Extract only information that appears in the document. Do not invent missing details. Use "Not found" when information is missing, except requested_action, which must be exactly "No action found" when absent. Summarize in no more than three short sentences. Mark urgency as High only when the document contains an immediate deadline, payment risk, legal or safety risk, or an explicit urgent request; otherwise use Medium or Low. Use only the allowed enum values. Return only the structured fields, nothing else.
